name: @pipeworx/mcp-bart

tools.name: bart_departures
tools.description: Real-time BART San Francisco Bay Area train departures for a station — next train departure times in minutes, per destination, with platform, direction, train length (cars), line color, delay, and bikes allowed. Station accepts a 4-letter BART code ("EMBR", "SFIA") or a station name ("Embarcadero", "Downtown Berkeley", "SFO"). Answers "when is the next BART train". Example: bart_departures({ station: "Embarcadero" })

station.description: BART station — 4-letter code like "EMBR", "MONT", "SFIA", or a name like "Embarcadero", "Powell", "Downtown Berkeley"

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own BART API key (defaults to the BART public key)

tools.name: bart_stations
tools.description: List all 50 BART San Francisco Bay Area train stations with 4-letter code, full name, city, street address, and coordinates. Optional filter matches station name or city (e.g. "Oakland", "Berkeley", "airport"). Use to find the station code for departures, trips, or fares. Example: bart_stations({ filter: "San Francisco" })

filter.description: Optional name or city filter, e.g. "Oakland", "airport", "Mission"

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own BART API key (defaults to the BART public key)

tools.name: bart_trip_planner
tools.description: Plan a BART trip between two Bay Area stations — the next trains from origin to destination with departure and arrival times, trip duration, legs (line, transfer stations, bikes), and the fare (Clipper and discount prices). Covers trips like SF to Oakland, Embarcadero to SFO airport, Berkeley to Millbrae. Stations accept 4-letter codes or names. Example: bart_trip_planner({ from: "Embarcadero", to: "SFIA" })

from.description: Origin station — code or name, e.g. "EMBR" or "Embarcadero"

to.description: Destination station — code or name, e.g. "SFIA" or "SFO airport"

trips.description: How many upcoming trips to return, 1-4 (default 4)

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own BART API key (defaults to the BART public key)

tools.name: bart_advisories
tools.description: Current BART service advisories and delays for the San Francisco Bay Area train system, plus elevator outage status at stations. Answers "is BART delayed right now", "are there BART service alerts", "which BART elevators are out". Example: bart_advisories({})

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own BART API key (defaults to the BART public key)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bart forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bart pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
